first-steps.title: First Steps
first-steps.blurb: Treble clef, C major, on the staff. Five intervals, nothing hidden.

treble-and-bass.title: Treble & Bass
treble-and-bass.blurb: Both common clefs, C major, the everyday intervals.

ledger-lines.title: Ledger Lines
ledger-lines.blurb: Treble and bass with the full range, so notes leave the staff.

sharp-keys.title: Sharp Keys
sharp-keys.blurb: Up to four sharps. The signature starts doing the work.

flat-keys.title: Flat Keys
flat-keys.blurb: Up to four flats, where the naturals are the surprise.

c-clefs.title: C Clefs
c-clefs.blurb: Alto and tenor only. Everything you know, moved.

tritone.title: The Tritone
tritone.blurb: Fourths and fifths only. Is that augmented or diminished?

everything.title: Everything
everything.blurb: All four clefs, all fifteen keys, every spelling in the catalog.

open-intervals.title: Open Intervals
open-intervals.blurb: Unison, fourth, fifth, octave. Ascending, on the staff, in C.

thirds-and-sixths.title: Thirds & Sixths
thirds-and-sixths.blurb: Major against minor, in the two places it matters most.

steps-and-sevenths.title: Steps & Sevenths
steps-and-sevenths.blurb: Seconds and sevenths — the narrow ones and their inversions.

ascending.title: All Ascending
ascending.blurb: Every interval, always upwards. The usual starting point.

descending.title: All Descending
descending.blurb: Every interval, always downwards. Harder than it sounds.

harmonic.title: Played Together
harmonic.blurb: Both notes at once, with no melodic shape to lean on.

harp.title: On the Harp
harp.blurb: The same intervals on a different instrument. Timbre off, ears on.

everything.title: Everything
everything.blurb: All intervals, all three directions, all four clefs.
